So selling for cash loses 38%; sell_credit keeps full in promissory — but last round's promissory isn't paid... promissory paid at start of round 6. Round 6 market still exists, then final. So promissory is added to cash at start of round 6 and survives? At end after last round promissory not paid. Round 6 start: cash devalued, then promissory added and zeroed. So promissory from round 5 is paid at start of round 6, and that cash... would be spent in round 6 market or devalue? No more devaluation after round 6. So sell_credit units 3: promissory 38.75M becomes cash at round 6 start, then round 6 I can sell... goods 0. I can still use that cash — but cash counts in final rank! Round 6 start devaluation applies to cash, then promissory added. So promissory 38.75M counts fully at final. Sell units 3 gives 31M cash now, devalued to 19.2M at round 6 start. So sell_credit is much better. Choice 6.
